MINUTES
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  AUGUST 19, 2025

  1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

  An adjourned meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills
  Estates was called to order at 6:01 p.m. at Ernie Howlett Park, 25851 Hawthorne Blvd.,
  Rolling Hills Estates, California, by CHAIR PERSICHINA.

  2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

  CHAIR PERSICHINA led those present in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  3.  ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present:  Persichina, Ciarolla, Johnson, Holdsworth and
  Bain

  Commissioners Absent:  Pope and McCormick

  City Staff Present:  Maintenance Superintendent Mike Goldsmith
  Community Services Supervisor Rosa Pinuelas
  Community Services Coordinator Matt Morrow

  4.  PRESENTATION

  A.  LINDEN H. CHANDLER PRESERVE OVERVIEW

  Cris Sarabia, Conservation Director with the Palos Verdes Peninsula Land
  Conservancy (PVPLC), gave a brief presentation updating the Commission
  regarding the operations at the Linden H. Chandler Preserve.

  Mr. Sarabia provided more information regarding the Rivers and Mountain
  Conservancy grant available for the PVPLC to utilize for various projects, in
  response to COMMISSIONER BAIN.

  Mr. Sarabia provided information regarding their native plant sales, in response to
  COMMISSIONER JOHNSON.

  5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  A.  PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING DRAFT MINUTES OF JULY 15,
  2025

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  1
AUGUST 19, 2025
   COMMISSIONER HOLDSWORTH made a motion, seconded by
  COMMISSIONER BAIN to:

  APPROVE THE PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MINUTES OF
  JULY 15, 2025.

  There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered.

  6.  AUDIENCE ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

  NONE.

  7.  BUSINESS ITEMS

  A.  MILITARY SERVICE MEMBER BANNER PROGRAM UPDATE

  Supervisor Pinuelas gave a brief update of the Military Service Member Banner
  program (as per the agenda material).

  Discussion ensued regarding the length of the banner program, the banner
  material and its ability to sustain weathering, sponsorship packages for banner
  program, and the capacity of banner program.

  COMMISSIONER HOLDSWORTH requested that the names and applications be
  vetted prior to approval and that the banners be printed following the stated criteria
  in the staff report.

  COMMISSION agreed with Staff’s recommendation to choose banner design #1
  for the banner program.

  There being no objection, CHAIR PERSICHINA so ordered to receive and file.

  7.  STAFF ITEMS

  A.  CONCERT IN THE PARK DEBRIEF (VERBAL REPORT)

  Coordinator Morrow provided a debrief regarding the Concert in the Park event on
  Saturday, July 19. He stated that the concert had good attendance, and that the
  crowd enjoyed the band “Good Cop, Bad Cop,” who performed for the entire two
  hour time slot. He also stated that Staff received positive feedback regarding the
  band and the quality of the sound production which was provided by Morning Star
  Productions.

  B.  CITY CELEBRATION UPDATE (VERBAL REPORT)

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  2
AUGUST 19, 2025
   Coordinator Morrow provided an update regarding the upcoming City Celebration
  event scheduled for Saturday, September 13 from 9:00 am to 3:00 pm at the Empty
  Saddle Club. He provided information regarding the programs and activities, the
  community and sponsor booths, the Poker Ride, the equestrian events, and the
  food and beverage options provided by vendors. He also provided an event
  sponsor update.

  **ADJOURNED TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD MEETING AT
  6:27 PM**

  C.  TRACY AUSTIN TENNIS TOURNAMENT UPDATE (VERBAL REPORT)

  Coordinator Morrow provided an update regarding the upcoming Tracy Austin
  Doubles Tennis Tournament scheduled from Friday, October 10 to Sunday,
  October 12. He provided information regarding the tournament director, location of
  the matches, the VIP/Sponsor reception, and the event sponsors to date.

  **RECONVENED PARKS AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING AT 6:29 PM**

  D.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE.
  8.  COMMISSION ITEMS

  A.  ADOPT-A-PARK (VERBAL REPORT)

  COMMISSIONER BAIN reported there was a portion of fencing that needed to be
  replaced at Silver Spur Park. She also requested trimming of some cacti that are
  behind some of the trees to allow better visibility of the cacti.

  In response to COMMISSIONER BAIN, Supervisor Pinuelas stated that a picnic
  bench was on a list for a potential future item, but that an updated ADA assessment
  would likely be required beforehand as a picnic table would be a new amenity at
  Silver Spur Park.

  Discussion ensued regarding the potential for adding parking for Silver Spur Park
  visitors and the lack of space available to create parking.

  COMMISSIONER JOHNSON reported that the dog waste bags needed to be
  restocked at Founder’s Park.

  B.  MATTERS OF INTEREST (VERBAL REPORT)

  NONE

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  3
AUGUST 19, 2025
   9.  MATTERS OF INFORMATION

  A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF JUNE 24, 2025

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  B.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF JULY 22, 2025

  RECEIVED AND FILED.

  **COMMISSIONER JOHNSON LEFT THE MEETING AT 6:35 PM**

  10.  PARK TOURS

  A.  ERNIE HOWLETT PARK

  The Commission and Staff conducted a park tour of Ernie Howlett Park.

  11.  ADJOURNMENT

  CHAIR PERSICHINA ADJOURNED THE MEETING AT 6:52 PM TO THE NEXT
  PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING ON SEPTEMBER 16, 2025,
  AT 6:00 P.M., WHICH WILL BE HELD IN THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER AT
  CITY HALL .

  There being no objection, so ordered.

  Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

  ___________________________  ___________________________
  Matt Morrow  Lou Persichina
  Community Services Coordinator  Chair, Park & Activities Commission

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES  4
AUGUST 19, 2025
